description: woce-backup: local backup and restore for webOS

services.name: com.palm.app.backup.service
services.description: Backs up data and settings to local storage and restores them

commands.name: healthcheck
commands.description: Returns 'ack', may be used to see if the service can be started

commands.name: register
commands.description: Registers a service to be called as part of backup/restore

commands.name: cancelBackup
commands.description: Cancels the backup currently in progress

commands.name: getBackupStatus
commands.description: Returns the backup status and, if subscribe is true, notifications when it changes

commands.name: getLastBackupTime
commands.description: Returns the time of the last successful backup

commands.name: optInToBackup
commands.description: Enables backup and schedules the next one

commands.name: optOutOfBackup
commands.description: Disables backup and removes all stored backups

commands.name: restore
commands.description: Restores a backup to this device

commands.name: reboot
commands.description: Reboots the device via the privileged helper

commands.name: getRestoreDevices
commands.description: Returns the devices available for restore, each with its available backups

commands.name: listBackups
commands.description: Returns every backup held by the current target

commands.name: deleteBackup
commands.description: Deletes a single backup and purges any files it alone referenced

commands.name: listTargets
commands.description: Returns the available backup targets and which one is selected

commands.name: setTarget
commands.description: Selects the backup target to use

commands.name: getUserDataCategories
commands.description: Returns the user data categories and whether each is enabled

commands.name: setUserDataCategories
commands.description: Sets which user data categories are included in a backup

commands.name: scheduledBackup
commands.description: Activity Manager callback for the daily scheduled backup
